brief:
Palestinian journalist and human rights defender Maha Hussaini has introduced her cat Tom in a podcast episode addressing the humanitarian catastrophe unfolding in Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. Hussaini described the animal as a fellow genocide survivor, framing pet ownership within the broader context of mass starvation affecting the territory.

The episode of The Gaza Podcast explores the moral weight of keeping a pet alive while civilians face severe food shortages. Hussaini's account reflects the impossible choices Palestinians confront as the humanitarian crisis deepens across Gaza.
dek: When saving your pet comes with guilt: The reality of starvation in Gaza In the latest episode of The Gaza Podcast, Palestinian journalist and human rights defender Maha Hussaini introduces her cat Tom, a fellow genocide survivor.
title: Journalist in Gaza raises cat amid widespread starvation crisis
